name: roblox-lighting
terminology_note: The canonical package name is 'roblox-lighting'; the common misspelling 'roblox-lightning' remains a discovery alias, while electrical lightning-bolt VFX are outside scope unless scene illumination is also requested.
primary_inputs: optional current settings or Studio audit

optional_dependencies.Pillow: required only for image_metrics.py and cluster_images.py
optional_dependencies.network: required for public Roblox-link research and web/image search
optional_dependencies.roblox_studio: recommended for direct implementation and visual validation

safety_defaults: do not claim exact hidden settings from one image
do not bypass authentication or access private Roblox data
do not copy unlicensed sky or texture assets
back up affected state before edits
preserve unmanaged instances unless conflict replacement is explicitly selected
never make gameplay-critical information depend only on post effects, color, or shadows
